author: CC
prose: The reseal door's rung 1 ("seal still reproduces", cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:534) returns `unchanged` without clearing a trouble that stands raised under the proof's seal-red identity, and validation_store's persist clears only on a verdict CHANGE (validation_store.py:893). So a timeout trouble (raised while the standing verdict stays green, reseal.py:655) outlives every later green: measured 2026-11-10, seal-red-cairn-devices-codemother-proofs-test-codemother stood at 5x after c42e4e436d6c PROVED and its proof sealed green at 07:08; `cairn test --reseal` said "seal still reproduces" and left it standing; CC cleared it by hand through ModuleRaiser. Rung 1 should clear a standing raise (via _stands_raised) when standing() reads the current bytes proven green.
